body:
BuildingItem Plugin
Overview
BuildingItem is a powerful Minecraft plugin designed to revolutionize your building experience. It allows players to save, manage, and instantly generate complex structures with ease. Whether you're building houses, castles, or intricate redstone contraptions, this plugin streamlines the process of replicating and sharing your creations.

Key Features
🏗️ Building Preservation & Generation
Save Structures: Select any region in your world and save it as a reusable building template

Instant Generation: Generate saved buildings anywhere with a simple magic wand

Smart Rotation: Buildings automatically rotate to face the player's direction

Preview System: Visual preview with particle effects before final placement

🛠️ Intuitive Tools
Selection Tool: Wooden stick for selecting building regions with visual particle boundaries

Building Wand: Blaze rod for generating specific saved structures

Smart Block Data: Preserves block orientations, states, and custom data

🌍 Dimension Management
Configurable Restrictions: Control which dimensions allow building generation

Flexible Settings: Enable/disable dimension restrictions as needed

Custom Messages: Personalized restriction messages for better user experience

⚙️ Advanced Management
Building Catalog: List all saved structures with block counts

Easy Deletion: Remove unwanted building templates

Data Persistence: All buildings survive server restarts

Permission System: Granular control over plugin features
